# OpenColor — full reference

OpenColor is a free browser app and open API that matches a measured color
(CIELAB, D65/2°) to named color standards, ranked by CIEDE2000. It reads a
Datacolor ColorReader (CR100) colorimeter over Web Bluetooth, and works as a
standalone color-lookup service for any client or agent.

## Capabilities

- Read CIELAB from a Datacolor ColorReader (and its paint-brand rebrands built on
  the same CR100 hardware) over Web Bluetooth in Chrome/Edge (desktop or Android).
- Match a CIELAB color to the nearest standards across ~11,400 references in eight
  systems: CSS named colors, RAL Classic, Pantone PMS Coated (C), Pantone PMS
  Uncoated (U), NCS, Munsell, Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore.

## Match API

Endpoint: `GET https://opencolor.app/api/match`
OpenAPI spec: https://opencolor.app/openapi.json
Auth: none. CORS: `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.

Query params:
- `L` (required, 0–100), `a` (required), `b` (required) — CIELAB D65/2°.
- `mode` — `per-system` (default; best match per system, ranked) or `pooled`
  (top-N nearest overall).
- `limit` — 1–50.
- `system` — restrict to one system id (ids in /data/index.json).

Example request:
`https://opencolor.app/api/match?L=53.24&a=80.09&b=67.20&limit=2`

Example response:
```json
{
  "query": { "L": 53.24, "a": 80.09, "b": 67.2 },
  "colorSpace": "CIELAB D65/2°",
  "deltaE": "CIEDE2000",
  "mode": "per-system",
  "count": 2,
  "matches": [
    { "system": "CSS Named Colors (X11/HTML)", "systemId": "css_named",
      "code": "red", "name": "red", "hex": "#ff0000",
      "L": 53.2, "a": 80.1, "b": 67.2, "deltaE": 0.04 },
    { "system": "RAL Classic", "systemId": "ral_classic",
      "code": "RAL 3026", "name": "Luminous bright red", "hex": "#FF0000",
      "L": 53.2, "a": 80.1, "b": 67.2, "deltaE": 0.04 }
  ]
}
```

## Datasets

- All colors, one file: https://opencolor.app/data/all.json
- Index of systems + per-system files: https://opencolor.app/data/index.json
- Per-system: https://opencolor.app/data/<systemId>.json

Each color: `{ system, systemId, code, name, hex, L, a, b, method }`. CIELAB is
D65/2°. `method` is `published` (from the source) or `derived_from_hex`.

## Device compatibility

The same CR100 hardware is white-labeled by paint brands. Per-device pages:
- https://opencolor.app/datacolor-colorreader
- https://opencolor.app/ppg-colorreader
- https://opencolor.app/benjamin-moore-colorreader
- https://opencolor.app/ral-color-reader
- https://opencolor.app/dunn-edwards-instacolor
- https://opencolor.app/caparol-colorreader
- https://opencolor.app/tikkurila-colorreader
- https://opencolor.app/dulux-colorreader
- https://opencolor.app/sherwin-williams-colorreader
- https://opencolor.app/lechler-colorreader

Only the Datacolor-branded unit is formally verified; the rebrands share the
hardware and should work.

## Notes

- Client-side app: scans and history stay in the browser.
- iOS cannot scan (no Web Bluetooth in WebKit); use Chrome/Edge on Android or desktop.
- On-screen swatches are sRGB approximations; the CIELAB and CIEDE2000 values are authoritative.
- Proprietary standards (Pantone, RAL, NCS) belong to their owners; values here are approximations for interoperability.
- Contact: hello@opencolor.app
